bundle.shortDescription: Game clipper for the Cos Nostra Discord
bundle.longDescription: Records the last minutes of gameplay with an embedded OBS replay buffer, saves clips on a hotkey and shares them with the Cos Nostra Discord community. The OBS runtime is downloaded on first launch.
